alerts.title: Iran war live: Houthis escalate attacks on Saudi capital

alerts.title: Oil Prices Rebound as Houthi Attacks Reignite Middle East Supply Fears

alerts.title: Iran Steps Up Hormuz Tanker Attacks as Oil Prices Slide
alerts.why: Increased tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz threaten a critical global oil chokepoint, raising geopolitical risk premiums and supply disruption fears.

alerts.title: WTI Crude Sinks More Than 5% as Global Oil Glut Fears Grow
alerts.why: WTI sank over 5% as rising global supply and growing U.S. inventories outweighed Middle East risk premiums, signaling a dominant bearish market trend.

alerts.title: Reports Claim Iran Is Preparing Oil Convoy to Test U.S. Blockade

alerts.title: Another Tanker Hit in Strait of Hormuz as Maritime Attacks Surge Worldwide
alerts.why: Tanker attack in the Strait of Hormuz directly threatens vital crude supply chokepoints, triggering severe geopolitical risk premiums.

itemsSent.title: AI Jitters Haven't Slowed the Bet on U.S. Power Demand
itemsSent.why: Rising data center power demand supports long-term natural gas consumption, though the impact on immediate 48-hour price action is limited.

itemsSent.title: Fed Likely to Raise Rates Again This Year
itemsSent.why: Higher interest rates strengthen the dollar and dampen economic growth expectations, reducing demand for crude oil.

itemsSent.title: Consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, more than expected, complicating Fed's inflation fight
itemsSent.why: Higher-than-expected inflation increases the likelihood of sustained high interest rates, strengthening the dollar and pressuring oil demand outlook.

itemsSent.title: IEA sees potential for looser oil, LNG markets after Hormuz crisis
itemsSent.why: IEA report highlighting potential for looser oil and LNG markets and lower prices if Middle East disruptions ease adds medium-term bearish pressure.

itemsSent.title: October’s firm inflation reading raises the question of whether Federal Reserve officials will accelerate increases at their December meeting or beyond.

itemsSent.title: Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan opens the door to a faster pace of hikes.
itemsSent.why: Hawkish Fed rhetoric strengthens the dollar and raises recession risks, weighing on crude oil demand expectations.

itemsSent.title: Mercosur’s Tax Break Is Fueling Brazil’s Oil Push Into Europe

itemsSent.title: BoJ Warns of Rising Inflation Risks, Reaffirms Rate-Hike Path
itemsSent.why: Hawkish BoJ policy strengthens the Yen, potentially dampening Japanese oil demand and signaling broader global tightening pressures on commodity consumption.

itemsSent.title: Natural gas storage sees unexpected decline, impacts market dynamics
itemsSent.why: Lower-than-expected injection into storage indicates tighter supply-demand balance, providing immediate support for natural gas prices.

itemsSent.title: US Weekly Oil Data
itemsSent.why: Weekly EIA data often causes short-term volatility; direction depends on the specific balance of inventory draws versus refinery utilization rates.
